scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "uv run $(test -f .env && echo --env-file .env) uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8000" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.start: npm run build && uv run $(test -f .env && echo --env-file .env) uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --port 8000
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend e2e *.json *.mjs && uv run ruff format backend
scripts.lint:frontend: prettier --check frontend e2e *.json *.mjs && eslint frontend e2e eslint.config.mjs
scripts.lint:backend: uv run ruff format --check backend && uv run ruff check backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && uv run ty check backend
scripts.check:quick: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend && npm run typecheck && npm run secrets && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check: npm run check:quick && npm run test:e2e
